title: Painting a Gravel Road
content: For this informal sketch of a gravel road crossing a stone bridge I use transparent watercolor because of the sparkling qualities it offers.(Link to YouTube) In the middle of the video I demonstrate a simple “salt and pepper” exercise to practice leaving random light spots in a dark background, and dark spots in a light background.ART SUPPLIESScarlet Pyrrol (watercolor)Cerulean blue (watercolor)Yellow ochre (watercolor)Cad yellow light (watercolor)Permanent green pale (watercolor)Burnt Sienna (watercolor)Watercolor sketchbookTravel brush setWater cup
